scope: Exact committed phone-files test harness delta only; no device or account acceptance

checks.newNoteOnlyPrivateReceipt: Live API exposes submitNoteFiles only; receipt registered internally after real UI create/save; current case rejects preexisting note ID; each receipt consumed before any attempt
checks.fixedPayloadsOnly: Frozen 68-byte PNG and deterministic 4096-byte binary, fixed names/MIME; caller cannot supply bytes/path/commands/extra arguments
checks.ownerAndAuthorization: Two full body/no-prior-attachments/native authorization checks around open; browser checks selected note and visible editable owner before command
checks.sessionPath: Existing debug attachment.submit -> bounded File[] -> capturePickerTarget/fileSelected -> AttachmentSubmission storage, insert and document ACK; no direct document overwrite, SQL, manual pairing or system picker claim
checks.bodyAndReferences: Exact known full body before submit; retain complete text document and exact plainText, allowing inserted attachment blocks/trailing empty editor paragraphs; exactly two refs; owned rows, MIME, size and bytes checked
checks.threePeersAndDisk: Complete document/plainText convergence on C/A/B; authorized production read bytes for all; A/B managed disk SHA256 against fixtures as well as production bytes
checks.baselineCleanup: Full original phone body, original attachment metadata/ref/raw byte preservation afterMerge/afterCatchUp/final remain; original helper/deadlines/finalization unchanged; failures remain failures after cleanup
checks.noRetryExpansion: One attempted phone submission per new note; errors fail case and skip later cases; no new login, network probe, timeout inflation or cleanup escape

knownLimits: Device-free VM and memory fixtures do not prove installed APK debug capability, editor selection behavior, native storage/ACK or real transport. Those remain live-run requirements.
This review follows unchanged product command source to verify harness contract; it is not a replacement native/UI product review or approval of a separately modified relogin runner.
